notes.title: A quick update on the development of the game
notes.notes:
Hello,

Just wanted to give a quick update.

Though the development of this game has been on hold for a couple of months, making it better is still on my mind.

I've been reading The Art of Game Design by Jesse Schell. It's a fantastic book and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to seriously learn about game design. It's given me new ideas. 

Accordingly, I expect the game will change significantly by the time it is completed.

Regards,
M

notes.title: Big Changes: v1.0.32
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to Update 1.0.32 of Those Left Behind! This update introduces significant changes to the game:

[olist]
 1st person perspective is now available, and is the default perspective
 music is available while scavenging the world and is turned on by default
 guns now have a functional dynamic crosshair (running, turning, shooting the gun, and getting hit by zombies affects the accuracy of the your gunshot)
 items and other interactables (e.g. doors) will now have an outline whenever you get close to them
[/olist]

Thanks for reading!
M

FULL PATCH NOTES
v1.0.32

Gameplay
1. add 1st person perspective (1st person prespective is now the default setting)
2. add music to world while scavenging (music is on by default, but can be turned off in the options menu)
3. add functional dynamic crosshair

Balance
1. slow down all melee weapon swings by about 20%
2. extend the range of all melee weapons
3. make EASY and NORMAL difficulty games start with essential supplies (eg food, water, medicine) and more building materials
4. decrease vision angle of 
	- normal & fallen zombies from 150 degrees to 130 degrees
	- tweaker zombies from 170 degrees to 150 degrees

Quality of Life
1. add outlines to objects when player is in range (note: size of range varies with difficulty; on "Easy", range is larger)
2. make load-game-menu text larger

Other
1. improve blood FX (blood impact splashes are larger and blood droplets are easier to see)
2. improve weapon hand & holster socket placement (e.g. before, some weapons locations & rotations looked strange in some characters' hands)
3. disable ability to aim when facing walls

notes.title: Small Patch Update - v1.0.29
notes.notes:
v1.0.29

Balance
1. make zombie defense scale with difficulty (e.g. on easy difficulty, killing a zombie takes less hits
2. push back the night at which events start for all difficulties (Easy -> 6; Normal -> 4; Hard -> 2)

Fix
1. improve Chinese localization
2. fix bug making player get "savagely attacked" every time when time expires (after bug fix, the chance of getting attacked and the amount of damage a player receives depends on the solar rating for that night)
3. increase frequency of generator glow (so generators are easier to see)

Other
1. add a more distinct icon for the player on the scavenging-level area map (for easier visibility)
2. draw distinct walls on all maps so rooms can more easily be distinguished
3. set main menu weather to be ALWAYS be "mostly clear" (so that Brightness/Visibility test will be more consistent)
4. make RadioBroadcast objective start at Night 3 (instead of Night 2)

notes.title: v1.0.22 Bug Fixes, Stun Time Balance, and Improving Ease of Use
notes.notes:
Fix
[olist]
 fix a bug introduced from an earlier patch for GameLevel "Apartments" which prevented players from entering a building (a ceiling was too low)
 fix kill volume (falling from board bridges between buildings in GameLevel "Apartments" kills players)
[/olist]
Balance
[olist]
 increase duration of all mini-stuns (hitting zombies will stun them for longer)
[/olist]
Other
[olist]
 add ease-of-use feature: players can press any key to transition through message screens with "continue" button
 add red flash animation if CreateNewGame button is pressed while SaveSlotName is empty
 add building material icons to building material thumbnails
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Combat and Item Glow Update
notes.notes:
A. Balance
[olist]
 make game difficulty affect object glow-frequency and glow-distance (the distance at which objects start glowing)

 at easy difficulty, items will glow more frequently and at a greater distance

 add mini-stun mechanic

upon receiving damage, zombies will be mini-stunned
the duration of the stun depends on:

 i. weapon type (heavy weapons add more stun time)
 ii. enemy type (fallen are stunned for less time than others)
 iii. headshot/sneak-attack
 improve fast zombie approach&attack AI
[/olist]

B. Other
[olist]
 add blood pools to recently killed zombies
 add more zombie hit reaction animations
 add camera shakes and distinct gore sounds to melee head-shots, sneak attacks
 add unique thumbnails for unique items
[/olist]
